llms.body:
# Localytics

> Localytics is an AI-implementation firm for enterprise marketing organizations. We build, integrate, and operate the autonomous agents that run CRM marketing execution, directed by an embedded team of strategists and engineers.

Localytics builds, integrates, and operates marketing AI for enterprise consumer brands. Autonomous agents handle the repetitive execution work of lifecycle and CRM marketing: detecting behavioral signals, deciding the next action, delivering across channels, and measuring outcomes at the customer level, while marketers direct strategy, creative, and judgment. We embed with your team, build the agents, run them with you, and measure against business results. We are not a self-serve platform and we do not sell seats.

Localytics today: Localytics is an independent company, spun out from Upland Software in March 2025 via investment from Palm Ventures. Today, the company serves as a technology-enabled consultancy for enterprise CRM and lifecycle marketing teams while continuing to operate its proprietary messaging and analytics platform. Localytics was acquired by Upland Software in February 2020 and operated as Upland Localytics. Founded in 2009, it began as a mobile analytics and engagement platform.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://localytics.com/): AI enablement for enterprise marketing teams, built on autonomous agents, behavioral signals, and human direction.
- [Platform](https://localytics.com/platform): The unified agent platform: behavioral data collection, multi-channel messaging across push, in-app, inbox, and email, journey orchestration, and behavioral predictions.
- [Services](https://localytics.com/services): Professional services: AI agent deployment for churn prevention, re-engagement, and upsell, plus analytics, campaign execution, integration, and advisory.
- [About](https://localytics.com/about): Independent since March 2025, formerly Upland Localytics; builds, integrates, and operates marketing AI, backed by an embedded team of strategists and engineers.
- [Team](https://localytics.com/team): The people behind Localytics.
- [Blog](https://localytics.com/blog): Insights on enterprise CRM marketing, AI agents, and behavioral data.
- [Contact](https://localytics.com/contact): Get in touch to scope an engagement.

## Platform capabilities

- [Brand Guidelines](https://localytics.com/platform/brand-guidelines): Generates on-brand campaign copy from your rules and a short prompt.
- [Churn Correlations](https://localytics.com/platform/churn-correlations): Ranks the behaviors most linked to churn so you know which to act on first.

## Featured writing

- [The Marketing Cloud is Broken](https://localytics.com/blog/the-marketing-cloud-is-broken): Why monolithic marketing clouds are the wrong shape for the agentic era.

## Optional

- [Jobs](https://localytics.com/jobs): Open roles at Localytics.
- [Privacy Policy](https://localytics.com/privacy): How Localytics handles data.
- [Terms of Service](https://localytics.com/terms): Terms governing use of the platform.
- [Security](https://localytics.com/security): Security practices and certifications.

AboutBlogTeamJobsGet in touch

    Marketing that works
    while you think.

    CRM Marketing is about strategy, creativity, and judgement. Let us handle the rest.

    Get in touch
    The Problem

    The Marketing Cloud is failing you.

    They don't sell themselves as a straitjacket, but the fit is uncanny. Guaranteed contracts lock you in before you've seen a result, months-long onboardings consume your team before any campaign ships, and certified partners charge for complexity they created. The system hasn't optimized your team. It has constrained them.

    Monolithic platforms are the wrong shape for the agentic era.

    The Shift
    Before
    • Segment building
    • Journey debugging
    • Send-time guesswork
    • Frequency capping nightmares
    • One consulting engagement per welcome email
    Now
    • Agents detect signals automatically
    • Decisions made on your data, your logic
    • Delivery on the right channel
    • Self-optimising from outcomes
    • No ticket required

    It's time to demand more.

    The CRM marketer's job should be about judgment and creativity, not configuration.

    The marketing operation that wins will run on clean data signals, headless infrastructure, and autonomous agents that handle the execution work. That's how your team gets back to the work that matters.

    What good looks like

    Agents do the work. Signals feed them. People direct.

    Agents

    Configured around your workflows, not the other way around.

    Detect a customer going quiet. Pick the right nudge. Send on the right channel. Measure what landed. Adjust. Repeat. No ticket required, no consulting engagement.

    DetectDecideDeliverMeasureLearn

    Signals

    Your behavioral data, not a third party's interpretation.

    Captured directly from your product: what users are doing right now, which features they adopted, who they are. Proprietary predictions built from it, portable to any agent.

    EventsProfilesPredictionsOutcomes

    People

    Marketers as directors.

    The week is spent on customer strategy, creative, and judgment. Not segment building. Not figuring out why the push didn't fire. Not waiting on a ticket.

    StrategyCreativeJudgmentReview

    Outcomes measured at the customer level. Not the audience. Not the campaign. The person.

    We know your stack.
    We have notes.

    We don't sell seats. We embed with your team, build the agents, and make sure they work.

    White-glove implementation and ongoing support from people who've run enterprise CRM programs, not people who've read about them.
